Enum Class TowerType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<TowerType>
be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.game.towers.TowerType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<TowerType>, Constable
public enum TowerType extends Enum<TowerType>
The playable tower types, as a polymorphic dispatcher over the Abstract Factory.

Each constant knows which factory method creates its concrete tower. This keeps the type → creation mapping in one place and keeps the game loop (Game) free of any switch/instanceof and free of imports of concrete tower classes.

Open/closed: adding a new tower type means adding a constant here (and a factory method) — Game is never touched. This enum depends only on the abstract EntityFactory and Tower, never on the concrete J2d* classes, so the game/visualization separation is preserved.
